nodes.name: Sign up
nodes.description: A visitor registers and receives an API token.

requirements.reason: Caller supplies the new account password (brought credential).

gen.reason: A new user row is created.
Response returns an API access token.

nodes.reasoning: apiSignup creates a User and returns an access token.

nodes.name: Log in
nodes.description: A visitor logs in and receives an API token.

gen.reason: Response returns an API access token.

nodes.reasoning: login authenticates and returns a token.

nodes.name: Log out (API)
nodes.description: A user invalidates their API access token.

requirements.reason: A valid access token identifies the caller.

nodes.reasoning: handleAPILogout deletes the caller's token.

nodes.name: Read own account
nodes.description: A user reads their own account info.
nodes.reasoning: viewMeAPI returns the authenticated user.

nodes.name: List own posts
nodes.description: A user lists their own posts.

gen.reason: Returns ids of the caller's posts.

nodes.reasoning: viewMyPostsAPI lists the caller's posts.

nodes.name: List own blogs
nodes.description: A user lists their own blogs.

gen.reason: Returns aliases of the caller's blogs.

nodes.reasoning: viewMyCollectionsAPI lists the caller's collections.

nodes.name: Change password
nodes.description: A user changes their own password.

requirements.reason: Current password proves control of the account.

nodes.reasoning: updatePassphrase replaces the caller's password.

nodes.name: Check username availability
nodes.description: A visitor probes whether a username is available.
nodes.reasoning: handleUsernameCheck reports whether a username is taken.

reachability_conditions: Open; confirm anon reachability at runtime.
gt.notes: Username-enumeration oracle; pair with runtime identity_statuses.

nodes.name: Render markdown
nodes.description: A visitor previews markdown rendered to HTML.
nodes.reasoning: handleRenderMarkdown renders markdown without persisting.

nodes.name: Create blog
nodes.description: A user creates a new blog (collection).
nodes.reasoning: newCollection creates a Collection owned by the caller.

nodes.name: Read blog
nodes.description: A reader reads a blog's public metadata.
nodes.reasoning: fetchCollection returns public blog metadata.

nodes.name: Update blog
nodes.description: A blog owner updates their blog settings.
nodes.reasoning: existingCollection (POST) updates blog fields.

nodes.name: Delete blog
nodes.description: A blog owner deletes their blog.
nodes.reasoning: existingCollection (DELETE) removes the blog.

nodes.name: List blog posts
nodes.description: A reader lists the posts of a blog.

gen.reason: Returns post ids of the blog.

nodes.reasoning: fetchCollectionPosts paginates a blog's posts.

nodes.name: Publish post
nodes.description: A blog owner publishes a post to their blog.
nodes.reasoning: newPost with a collection creates a published post.

nodes.name: Read blog post
nodes.description: A reader reads one post of a blog.

gen.reason: Returns the post and its id.

nodes.reasoning: fetchPost returns a single collection post.

nodes.name: Edit blog post
nodes.description: A blog owner edits one of their published posts.
nodes.reasoning: existingPost updates a collection post.

visibility.reason: Owner edit of a published post.

nodes.name: Move posts into blog
nodes.description: A user moves posts into one of their blogs.

requirements.reason: Edit token authorizing the move of an anon post.

gen.reason: Post is placed in the destination blog.

nodes.reasoning: addPost moves posts into the target collection.

reachability_conditions: Authenticated; holds the post edit token.

nodes.name: Pin post
nodes.description: A blog owner pins a post to the blog navigation.
nodes.reasoning: pinPost pins a post.

nodes.name: Unpin post
nodes.description: A blog owner unpins a post from the blog navigation.
nodes.reasoning: pinPost (unpin) removes a pinned post.

nodes.name: Create anonymous post
nodes.description: A visitor creates an anonymous post and receives an edit token.

gen.reason: A new anonymous/draft post is created.
Response returns an edit token for the author.

nodes.reasoning: newPost without a collection creates an anonymous post + edit token.

gt.notes: The returned edit token is the capability that later authorizes edit/delete/claim.

nodes.name: Claim anonymous posts
nodes.description: A user claims anonymous posts into their account using edit tokens.

requirements.reason: Edit token proving control of the anonymous post.

gen.reason: Post becomes owned by the caller.

nodes.reasoning: addPost (claim) ties anonymous posts to the account.

visibility.reason: Associate anonymous posts with an account.

reachability_conditions: Authenticated; holds the post edit token.

nodes.name: Unclaim posts
nodes.description: A user removes (unclaims) posts from their account.
nodes.reasoning: dispersePost removes posts from the caller's account.

nodes.name: Read post
nodes.description: A reader reads a post directly by its id.

gen.reason: Returns the post and its id.

nodes.reasoning: fetchPost returns a post by id.

nodes.name: Edit post
nodes.description: An author edits a post via account ownership or the post edit token.
nodes.reasoning: existingPost updates a post, authorized by owner or edit token.

visibility.reason: Edit via ownership or edit token.

reachability_conditions: Post owner (session/token) or anon edit-token holder.

nodes.name: Delete post
nodes.description: An author deletes a post via account ownership or the post edit token.
nodes.reasoning: deletePost removes a post, authorized by owner or edit token.

visibility.reason: Delete via ownership or edit token.

reachability_conditions: Post owner or anon edit-token holder.

nodes.name: Read post property
nodes.description: A reader reads a single property of a post.

gen.reason: Returns the requested property of a known post.

nodes.reasoning: fetchPostProperty returns one field of a post.

nodes.name: Delete user (admin)
nodes.description: An administrator deletes a user account.
nodes.reasoning: handleAdminDeleteUser removes a user account.

nodes.name: Toggle user status (admin)
nodes.description: An administrator suspends or re-activates a user.
nodes.reasoning: handleAdminToggleUserStatus flips a user's suspended flag.

nodes.name: Reset user password (admin)
nodes.description: An administrator resets another user's password.
nodes.reasoning: handleAdminResetUserPass sets a user's password.
